Kei Shindō (Japanese: 真堂圭 Shindō Kei) is a Japanese voice actress for and . 

==Biography==
Shindō was born on September 10, 1984, in , . Shindō began her work during , where her major roles include and various characters of the day. In , she picked up the role of Miette, replacing Saori Hayashi halfway into the series. In , Shindō's roles include , one of ; and , nicknamed Mimikins. Shindo is currently affiliated with the talent group Axlone.
